question: Who among the following founded the Kalakshetra Foundation in Chennai that is an important centre for the study and performance of fine arts?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rukmini Devi Arundale.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rukmini Devi Arundale:-**

 
 
• She was a dancer, choreographer, and social reformer who played a major role in the revival of Indian classical dance.
 
• She was born in England to an English mother and an Indian father, and she was educated in both Western and Eastern traditions. 
 
• **In 1928, Arundale founded the Kalakshetra Foundation, a dance school and cultural center in Chennai, India.**
 
• Kalakshetra became a leading institution for the study of Bharatanatyam, a classical Indian dance form. Arundale also founded the National School of Drama in New Delhi, and she served as its director from 1954 to 1958.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Yamini Krishnamurthy:-**

 
 
• **She is a Bharatanatyam dancer, choreographer, and teacher. **
 
• She is a disciple of Rukmini Devi Arundale and a leading exponent of the Pandanallur style of Bharatanatyam. Krishnamurthy has performed extensively throughout India and abroad.
 
• She has also choreographed several dance dramas, including "Sita Swayamvaram" and "Sati Savitri".
 
• She is a recipient of the Padma Bhushan, India's third-highest civilian award.
 
 
 
• **Mrinalini Sarabhai:-**
 
 
• **She was a dancer, choreographer, and social activist. **
 
• She was a disciple of E. Krishna Iyer and a leading exponent of the Mohiniyattam style of Indian dance. Sarabhai was born in Ahmedabad, India.
 
• She studied dance from a young age and began performing professionally in the 1930s.
 
• She was also a member of the Indian National Congress and was active in the Indian independence movement.
 
 
 
• **Alarmel Valli:-**
 
 
• **She is a Bharatanatyam dancer, choreographer, and teacher. **
 
• She is a disciple of Yamini Krishnamurthy and a leading exponent of the Pandanallur style of Bharatanatyam. 
 
• Valli has performed extensively throughout India and abroad.
 
• She has also choreographed several dance dramas, including "Amma" and "The Epic of Rama". She is a recipient of the Padma Shri, India's fourth-highest civilian award.
